goal.title: Daily hydration goal
goal.why_body: Staying hydrated supports energy, focus, and overall wellbeing. Your daily goal is a friendly target to help you build a consistent habit — not a medical prescription.
goal.auto_prefix: When enabled, we estimate your goal as
goal.auto_suffix: , then round to the nearest 50 ml so it fits the slider nicely. This follows a common guideline many apps use as a starting point.
goal.control_body: turn auto-calculate off anytime and nudge the slider until the number feels right for you.

presets.title: Drink presets
presets.quick_body: Presets are your three favorite volumes for logging water fast — the same chips you see when you add a drink from the home flow.
presets.tune_suffix: . For example, set one preset to 250 ml for your tea mug, or 750 ml for your gym bottle — then logging is one tap instead of typing every time.
presets.tip: Tip: pick round numbers you actually pour in real life. Small tweaks here make your day-to-day tracking feel effortless.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.gentle_body: Reminders help you spread sips across the day so you don't play catch-up at bedtime. Pick an interval that matches your routine, or turn them off whenever you need a quiet day.
reminders.quiet_body: Set a window when the app should stay silent — for example overnight while you sleep. Outside those hours, reminders can resume on your chosen interval.
reminders.quiet_note: Quiet hours only apply when reminders are turned on. If you pick "Off", we won't send interval reminders at all.

privacy_policy.title: Privacy policy
privacy_policy.intro:
This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use Daily Water Tracker and related services.

We use your data to provide hydration tracking, sync your progress across devices, send optional reminders, and improve app reliability — not for unrelated advertising.
privacy_policy.collect_account: Account details you provide (such as email, display name, and profile photo) when you sign in or edit your profile.
privacy_policy.collect_hydration: Hydration data you log (drink type, volume, date, and time) and derived statistics such as weekly activity.
privacy_policy.collect_preferences: App preferences you set, including daily goal, drink presets, theme, and reminder schedule.
privacy_policy.collect_notifications: Device notification permission status, used only if you enable reminders.
privacy_policy.collect_diagnostics: Diagnostic and usage data (for example crash reports and anonymous analytics) to maintain security and fix issues.
privacy_policy.use_sync: To store, display, and sync your hydration history and profile across your signed-in devices.
privacy_policy.use_reminders: To deliver optional hydration reminders you configure in the app.
privacy_policy.use_insights: To calculate progress, statistics, achievements, and in-app insights.
privacy_policy.use_improve: To operate the service, prevent abuse, and improve performance and stability.
privacy_policy.sharing_processors: We use trusted infrastructure providers (such as Google Firebase for authentication, cloud storage, and analytics) that process data on our behalf under their own terms and security standards.
privacy_policy.sharing_no_sell: We do not sell your personal information to third parties.
privacy_policy.rights_delete: You can delete your account and associated data from the app at any time (see Account → More).
privacy_policy.rights_contact: You may contact us to ask about your data or request correction where applicable.
privacy_policy.contact_body: If you have questions about this policy, email us at:
